cover.report_type: Year-End Report: January 31 of each year

_meta.notes: Handwritten, raised superscript cents. Column B is BLANK on both Lines 1 and 2 (recorded "", not 0). Lines 1, 2, 4 and 6 Column A are small hand-drawn circles (zeros). No Final/Dissolution box is checked despite the clerk filename 'finalreport' - only the Year-End box, signed 1/14/05 and stamped JAN 19 2005, i.e. the year-end report for calendar 2004 (the clerk listing's '2004 Summary Report'). Line 7 (1,144.03) matches the 1/30/06 year-end's Line 3.

contributions.detail: Schedule A (p3) is the printed form with every data row empty; the TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED cell carries a small hand-drawn circle (zero) and the SUBTOTAL cell was left blank. Matches Summary Page line 1 Column A. A real zero.

expenditures.detail: Schedule B (p4) is the printed form with every data row empty; the TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE cell carries a small hand-drawn circle (zero) and the SUBTOTAL cell was left blank. Matches Summary Page line 2 Column A. A real zero.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: no SUBTOTAL figure is printed on either page; the schedule TOTAL cells each carry a hand-drawn zero against zero rows, so 0 = 0 on both
itemized.notes: BLANK SCHEDULES, both sides. Header boxes read 'Page 3 of 4 / Swensen / 1/14/05' and 'Page 4 of 4 / Swensen / 1/14/05'. PAGE 5 IS NOT A SCHEDULE - it is a WELLS FARGO BANK STATEMENT for the 'SHERRIE SWENSEN CAMPAIGN COMMITTEE' Low Activity Business Checking account, statement end date 12/31/04, marked 'Page 1 of 3' (only its first page is in this PDF). It shows a beginning and ending balance of 1,144.03 with a single 2.00 fee and its 2.00 reversal in December 2004. It is an attachment, NOT an itemized schedule, so nothing on it is transcribed as a contribution or expenditure row. Its 1,144.03 is the account balance, not a Schedule A/B figure. The clerk filename says 'finalreport' but the form checks only the January-31 year-end box (recorded in the earlier totals pass).
